verified_facts.study: brainSCOPE (PsychENCODE Consortium phase II integrative analysis)
verified_facts.citation: Emani PS, Liu JJ, Clarke D, et al. Single-cell genomics and regulatory networks for 388 human brains. Science 384, eadi5199 (2024). doi:10.1126/science.adi5199
verified_facts.tissue: adult dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC), post-mortem; all samples >= 13 years (supp. §1)
verified_facts.diagnoses: 182 controls + schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, ASD, Alzheimer's disease, PTSD and others (diagnosis is a QTL covariate)
verified_facts.sample_metadata_cmc_id_prefix: all 100 CMC individuals carry CMC_MSSM_* IDs (Mount Sinai brain bank)
verified_facts.genome_build: GRCh38/hg38 (genotypes lifted to hg38, REF fixed to hg38 with plink2; supp. §1). Verified empirically: 108,485 brainSCOPE core pairs match eQTL Catalogue GRCh38 chr:pos:REF:ALT with 99.99% sign concordance (data/sprint5/brainscope_allele_check.json)
verified_facts.genotypes: SNP array / WES / WGS / snRNA-derived calls, merged, TOPMed imputation server (Minimac4, Eagle 2.4, R2>0.3); post-imputation MAF>=0.05 and present in all samples: 1.95M SNPs, 383 samples (supp. §1). Public candidate SNP lists contain 1,953,861 IDs per cell type (L6b).
verified_facts.gene_annotation: NOT STATED for the scQTL gene coordinates. Genes are identified by SYMBOL only; TSS from a 'genes.gtf' (build_gene_info_file.py). snRNA counts from CellRanger v6.0 (supp. §2); the 10x reference/GENCODE release used is not given in the supplement text searched. GENCODE 43 is cited only for conservation annotations. Treat symbol matching as approximate.
verified_facts.expression_unit: pseudobulk mean UMI per individual & cell type (>50 nuclei of that type, >300 nuclei total), log2(CPM+1), genes with >10% non-zero samples; QTLtools --normal (rank-normal) phenotype
verified_facts.scQTL_method: QTLtools cis, 1 Mb up/downstream of TSS; covariates sex, age, diagnosis, cohort, 5 genotype PCs, 100 expression PCs (20 for small cell types); 10,000 permutations; beta-approximated gene p; Storey q<=0.05 per cell type; per-gene nominal threshold F^-1(pt) (GTEx scheme).
verified_facts.significance_scope: SIGNIFICANT PAIRS ONLY are public (eGene q<=0.05 and pair nominal p <= gene threshold). No full nominal (all tested pairs) summary statistics are published on the portal; the supplement and portal list none. Tested SNP lists and pseudobulk matrices ARE public, so 'tested' status is known; genotypes are controlled-access, so full statistics cannot be regenerated.
verified_facts.effect_allele: slope per copy of the ALT allele of variant ID chr:pos:REF:ALT (hg38). Basis: QTLtools uses VCF ALT dosage; empirically 99.99% sign concordance with eQTL Catalogue (ALT-coded) bulk brain eQTLs for 5,602 unique gene-variant pairs.

cell_types.why_7_missing: covariate files show residual df <= 21 (Endo__VLMC 3, Sncg 21) or negative (Immune, L5.ET, L6.IT.Car3, Pax6, SMC); the paper reports core scQTLs for 17 cell types. These are NOT 'tested, no eQTL'.

qtl_types_public.cell-class eQTL (aggregated excitatory/i: VERIFIED NOT A SEPARATE ANALYSIS: sorted contents are byte-identical to concatenations of the per-cell-type core files (excitatory = 7 excitatory types; inhibitory = 5 inhibitory types; non_neuronal = Astro+OPC+Oligo+Micro.PVM); excluded from the lookup
qtl_types_public.conditional eQTL: top variant per independent signal, 17 cell types
qtl_types_public.Bayesian LMM scQTL: 24 cell types; posterior mean + SD; significant only
qtl_types_public.isoform-usage QTL (sQTLseekeR2): 22 cell types; isoGenes with beta p<0.05 (unfiltered for FDR; only 21 isoGenes at FDR<0.05 per paper); unsigned; TSS +/-5 kb window
qtl_types_public.caQTL: NONE published (no chromatin-accessibility QTLs in brainSCOPE)
qtl_types_public.sQTL (leafcutter-style splicing): NONE published; isoform-usage QTLs are the closest analogue

regulatory_annotations_public.scCRE peaks: snATAC/snMultiome peak calls for 7 classes (Astro, Endo, Exc, Inh, Micro, OPC, Oligo) + union; hg38 BED
regulatory_annotations_public.GRNs: 23 cell-type TF-enhancer-promoter-target gene networks (SCENIC + scGRNom + snATAC links); enhancer->target gene links used as enhancer-gene links
regulatory_annotations_public.eQTL_edge: scQTLs overlapping GRN enhancer/promoter elements, 24 GRN cell types

verified_facts.licence_terms: Portal states output files are 'fully open source'; files are served without login or click-through. No explicit data licence found. Code: MIT License for Academic Use (commercial use: contact M. Gerstein).

overlap_with_project_bulk_eqtl.CommonMind (eQTL Catalogue QTD000075, n=: LIKELY OVERLAP: brainSCOPE CMC cohort = 100 CMC_MSSM_* donors (the core scQTL covariates flag 25-93 CMC samples per cell type); CommonMind bulk DLPFC eQTLs include MSSM donors. Individual-level overlap cannot be confirmed without controlled IDs.
overlap_with_project_bulk_eqtl.ROSMAP (eQTL Catalogue ROSMAP brain_naiv: LIKELY OVERLAP: brainSCOPE includes 46 ROSMAP individuals (ROS*/MAP* IDs; 1-43 per cell type in QTL covariates).
overlap_with_project_bulk_eqtl.GTEx: NO OVERLAP expected: no GTEx cohort in brainSCOPE.
overlap_with_project_bulk_eqtl.SZBDMulti-Seq: 72 donors (24 control / 24 schizophrenia / 24 bipolar; 'SZBD-Kellis', supp. §4.3). Brain bank not stated in the supplement; the design resembles the McLean (HBTRC) cohort of Ruzicka et al. 2024 (PMID 38781388), so overlap with CommonMind MSSM donors is judged unlikely but is UNVERIFIED.
overlap_with_project_bulk_eqtl.LIBD: 10 LIBD donors (Br* IDs) - LIBD/BrainSeq bulk data are not among the project's bulk eQTL sources (BrainSeq is NON_ADULT-labelled in the Sprint-4 eQTL Catalogue table).
overlap_with_project_bulk_eqtl.consequence: agreement between brainSCOPE and CommonMind/ROSMAP bulk directions is not independent replication.
